description: Source code for CKEditor plugin 'htmlwriter', defining the CKEDITOR.htmlWriter class used for generating HTML content programmatically.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlWriter
classes.description: Class used to write HTML data, providing methods to generate HTML tags, attributes, comments, and manage formatting rules.

methods.name: openTag
methods.description: Writes the opening part of an HTML tag with attributes.

methods.name: openTagClose
methods.description: Writes the closing part of an opening HTML tag, handling self-closing tags.

methods.name: attribute
methods.description: Writes an attribute for the current tag.

methods.name: lineBreak
methods.description: Inserts a line break in the output.

methods.name: indentation
methods.description: Inserts indentation based on current rules.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Sets formatting rules for specific HTML tags.
